entities.summary: Louis Joseph Marie Théodore de Goesbriand was a French-born prelate of the Catholic Church. He served as the first bishop of the Diocese of Burlington in Vermont from 1853 until his death in 1899. His cause for canonization was initiated by the Diocese of Burlington in 2019.
